Best Power Station for a Sump Pump

A 1/2-HP sump pump pulls about 900 W running and up to 2,500 W for a second at start-up, so surge matters more than capacity.

Safety: Backfeeding a panel, double-male "suicide" cords and dryer-outlet hookups can electrocute line workers.

A hard-wired sump pump needs a transfer switch or interlock installed by a licensed electrician.

What not to do

  • Backfeed through a dryer outlet
  • Run a gas generator in the garage
  • Bypass the BMS to charge a cold battery

Unlike a gas generator, a power station is safe to use indoors. Plug the pump's cord straight into the station; see the compatibility hub for cables.

Warning: Never run a generator in a basement or garage, even with the door open.
